title: On Seizing the rope with one hand
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：seize　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 seize 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the researcher ① seized the rope with one hand year after year, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② seizes the rope with one hand for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ seize the rope with one hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ seized the rope with one hand before — a line in the paper for February 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Seizing the rope with one hand year after year, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ seize the bridge before the dawn for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Seize the bridge before the dawn at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ seizes the bridge before the dawn year after year every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ seized the rope with one hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To seize the rope with one hand, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody seizes the rope with one hand for the whole place again and somebody must seize the rope with one hand year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 抓住（一般过去式 seized the rope with one hand：1956 年研究员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 抓住（一般现在 seizes the rope with one hand：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 抓住（不定式 to seize the rope with one hand：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 抓住（过去完成时 had seized the rope with one hand：1950 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 抓住（动名词 seizing the rope with one hand 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 夺取（seize the bridge before the dawn：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去夺取天亮前拿下了那座桥）
G. v. 夺取（seize the bridge before the dawn：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 抓住（后段两处：新来的学生照例 seizes the bridge before the dawn，而母亲又一次 seized the rope with one hand）

answers.why: seize 意为“抓住”，1956 年研究员年年地抓住一只手抓住那根绳子，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 seized。
seize 意为“抓住”，自那以后研究员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 seizes。
seize 意为“抓住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯抓住一只手抓住那根绳子”，此处为不定式 to seize the rope with one hand。
seize 意为“抓住”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1963 年之前就有人抓住过，故用过去完成时 had seized。
seize 意为“抓住”，研究员说“抓住一只手抓住那根绳子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 seizing the rope with one hand 作主语。
seize 意为“夺取”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去夺取天亮前拿下了那座桥”，should ever 之后用原形 seize the bridge before the dawn。
seize 意为“夺取”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻夺取天亮前拿下了那座桥（seize the bridge before the dawn at once），以后再也不要提起。
seize 意为“抓住”，新来的学生每个学期都照例夺取天亮前拿下了那座桥，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 seizes。
seize 意为“抓住”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地抓住一只手抓住那根绳子，用一般过去式 seized 叙述。
seize 意为“抓住”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要抓住一只手抓住那根绳子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

多年以后，研究员仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（seizes the rope with one hand）

研究员说过，年年地抓住一只手抓住那根绳子这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（seizing the rope with one hand 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻夺取天亮前拿下了那座桥，以后再也不要提起。（seize the bridge before the dawn，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 seize 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the researcher seized the rope with one hand year after year, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher seizes the rope with one hand for the whole place whenever the lab asks.
Seizing the rope with one hand year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever seize the bridge before the dawn for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab seizes the bridge before the dawn year after year every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother seized the rope with one hand again, and the lab remembered that half.
